title: Noor and the Cipher
author: Petra Blackwood
blurb: Rafael Fairweather, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
